''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

'''"The Wheel of Time"''' translates to "''چرخ زمان''" in Persian. The Persian editions of Wheel of Time are published by Parian. Each book is divided into two parts by the Persian publisher. There are four books published so far with the last appearing in 2023. The books are translated by Behrang Mafi and edited by Banafsheh Mahmoudi

Robert Jordan's name in Persian is  "'''رابرت جوردن'''".

==Book Titles==
The publication dates are listed online using the Persian calendar e.g. the most recent book was published in 1400/12/11. They have been converted to the Gregorian calendar.

1. '''چشم جهان''' ''The Eye of the World'' (2018)  
* Part 1: '''خروج از دورود''' ''From the Two Rivers''
* Part 2:'''ورود به مرگ‌زار''' ''Into the Blight''

2. '''شکار بزرگ''' ''The Great Hunt'' (2019)
* Part 1:  '''شکار آغاز''' ''The Hunt Begins''
* Part 2: '''رشته‌ای نو در الگو''' A New Thread in the Pattern

3. '''تجلی اژدها''' ''The Dragon Reborn'' (2021)
* Part 1: '''جهان رویاها''' ''The World of Dreams''
* Part 2: '''توفانی در تیر''' ''A Storm in Tear''

4. '''خیزش تاریکی''' ''The Shadow Rising'' (2022)
* Part 1: '''بذرهای تاریکی''' Seeds of Shadow
* Part 2: '''چرخ زمان''' Rhuidean Traps
